patch.value: List closed issues under Fixed only when a repair is recorded

Require tracker repair evidence before classifying closed issues as Fixed; use neutral Closed entries for factual closures and omit non-change dispositions. Repro: pm-github-n0mm; classifier history: pmc-874d.
Real-shaped classifier table, historical incident repro, full snapshot, no-git stdin and tracker input, behavioural revert proof, unchanged npm and Bun release gates, regenerated own changelog.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Search found no existing evidence-based closure feature; pmc-874d is historical classifier precedence work. Design: for closed Issue/Bug/Bugfix/Defect records, explicit non-change dispositions in close_reason or resolution take precedence and are excluded. Other closures require linked files/tests, explicit affirmative repair wording in close_reason/resolution, or delivered/merged PR or commit evidence in resolution/actual_result/links; otherwise render Closed: title under Closed. Type/tag/title alone is not repair evidence. Features and Tasks retain existing classification. All projections use one selection policy; JSON reports non-change exclusions. Tracker data only; preserve existing release placement and prepend history. Fixtures will use sanitized SDK/fleet field shapes, including source closure timestamps and GitHub completion wording.
